metadata.title: देसी चिकन और महुआ की महक | Desi Chicken Cooked in Aromatic Mahua Wine | The Tribal Kitchen
metadata.description:
In this special episode of Tribal Kitchen, we travelled to the picturesque village of Konatoli, nestled in Gumla district, Jharkhand, to explore an authentic tribal culinary experience. The heart of the episode features the preparation of Desi Chicken, a cherished local dish, cooked with a unique and flavorful twist — Mahua wine. Mahua, a flower deeply rooted in tribal culture, is traditionally fermented to produce a mildly sweet, aromatic wine. It enhances the dish with a rich, earthy flavour and represents the community’s enduring connection to nature.

As the chicken simmers in the Kadahi over an open fire, the Mahua wine infuses the meat with a distinctive aroma, creating a mouthwatering, tender delicacy. This dish is more than a meal — it’s a reflection of the Oraon tribe's culinary traditions and their resourceful use of local ingredients.

Throughout the episode, we also capture the vibrant essence of village life, the warmth of the people, and the stories that make their food culture so special. Join us on this flavorful journey to celebrate the simplicity, ingenuity, and rich heritage of Jharkhand’s tribal communities — one bite at a time.
